model.pooling: mean ordinary assistant-response tokens excluding prompt and im_end

inputs.activation_axis_authentication: literal pair_order plus exact per-response content hashes plus state-to-response bindings
inputs.group_atomicity: Collection-isolated split; deterministic normalized-question dedup priority test then dev then train, where identity is Unicode NFKC plus whitespace collapse plus casefold; exact final inventory is bound in the split freeze

multilayer_ensemble.name: equal28_train_standardized_scores
multilayer_ensemble.definition: For each layer, standardize response scores using only that training fit's response-score mean and standard deviation; average all 28 standardized layer scores with equal fixed weight 1/28.

metrics.provider_batch_sensitivity: descriptive bootstrap by the frozen atomic_group_id (C1000 lane cooldown chain; CF200 document; CF2 canary/scale shard; CF3 shard) when nonempty

interpretation_limits: No test or external result may select a layer, sign, hyperparameter, row, threshold, or ensemble weight.
The 113-row CF3 cohort was already scored by frozen methods and is an external robustness set, not a fresh confirmation.
Paired ordering measures expressed confidence separation; it does not establish factual correctness, intrinsic confidence, causal mechanism, or SDT benefit.
No language-model weights are updated by these logistic readouts.
